subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should per-run plugin resource ownership become a supported public `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` contract, or should this browser fix use a narrower bundled-browser ownership seam?
rationale: The field is additive but creates a durable external Plugin SDK promise; correctness tests cannot decide whether that general-purpose API belongs in the supported surface.

options.title: Accept the documented SDK contract
options.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId` field, retain the documentation and factory-boundary tests, and require real browser-service lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep ownership browser-internal
options.body: Remove the public tool-context addition and pass run ownership through a narrower internal bundled-browser runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the documented SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId` field, retain the documentation and factory-boundary tests, and require real browser-service lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide Plugin SDK boundary decision rather than a mechanical browser implementation choice.
